description: Total historical bids by this competitor across all time and locations
Fraction of all historical projects where this competitor submitted a bid
Number of bids submitted in the 3 months before this project's bid date
formula: COUNT(bids WHERE competitor = c AND bid_date >= project_bid_date - 90d)

description: Number of bids submitted in the 6 months before this project's bid date
formula: COUNT(bids WHERE competitor = c AND bid_date >= project_bid_date - 180d)

description: Number of bids submitted in the 9 months before this project's bid date
formula: COUNT(bids WHERE competitor = c AND bid_date >= project_bid_date - 270d)

description: Number of bids submitted in the 12 months before this project's bid date
formula: COUNT(bids WHERE competitor = c AND bid_date >= project_bid_date - 365d)

description: Number of bids submitted in the 24 months before this project's bid date
formula: COUNT(bids WHERE competitor = c AND bid_date >= project_bid_date - 730d)

description: Days since this competitor's most recent bid (9999 if no history)
formula: project_bid_date - MAX(bid_date WHERE competitor = c); 9999 if no history

description: Prior bids in the same state as this project
formula: COUNT(bids WHERE competitor = c AND state = project_state)

description: Prior bids in the same county as this project
formula: COUNT(bids WHERE competitor = c AND county = project_county)

description: Prior bids on the exact same project_type as this project
formula: COUNT(bids WHERE competitor = c AND project_type = this_project_type)

description: Prior bids on the same project_family as this project
formula: COUNT(bids WHERE competitor = c AND project_family = this_project_family)

Binary: competitor has at least one prior bid on the same project_family (0/1)

description: Ratio of asphalt tons won year-to-date vs. competitor's historical average annual tonnage; estimates how much capacity is already committed
formula: ytd_won_tons / avg_annual_won_tons; 0 if no bid_year data or no prior wins

description: Flag: project has no geocoordinates so all pit distances are unknown (0/1)
Distance in miles to the nearest publicly open pit (9999 if no project coordinates)
formula: MIN(haversine_miles(project_loc; pit_loc) for pit in open_pits); 9999 if no coordinates

description: Count of publicly open pits within 10 miles of this project
Count of publicly open pits within 25 miles of this project
Count of publicly open pits within 50 miles of this project
Highest quality rating among open pits within 25 miles
formula: MAX(pit.Rating for pit in open_pits WHERE distance <= 25 miles)

description: Average quality rating among open pits within 25 miles
formula: MEAN(pit.Rating for pit in open_pits WHERE distance <= 25 miles)

description: Distance in miles to the nearest pit with unknown access status (9999 if no coordinates)
formula: MIN(haversine_miles(project_loc; pit_loc) for pit in unknown_access_pits); 9999 if no coordinates

description: Count of pits with unknown access status within 25 miles
Flag: at least one unknown-access pit exists within 25 miles (0/1)
Distance in miles to the nearest accessible pit (open + unknown-access + competitor-owned) (9999 if no coordinates)
formula: MIN(haversine_miles(project_loc; pit_loc) for pit in accessible_pits); 9999 if no coordinates

description: Count of accessible pits (open + unknown-access + competitor-owned) within 10 miles
Count of accessible pits within 25 miles
Count of accessible pits within 50 miles
Highest quality rating among accessible pits (open + unknown-access + competitor-owned) within 25 miles
formula: MAX(pit.Rating for pit in accessible_pits WHERE distance <= 25 miles)

description: Average quality rating among accessible pits within 25 miles
formula: MEAN(pit.Rating for pit in accessible_pits WHERE distance <= 25 miles)

description: Distance in miles to this competitor's nearest owned/restricted pit (9999 if none)
formula: MIN(haversine_miles(project_loc; pit_loc) for pit in competitor_owned_pits); 9999 if none

description: Count of this competitor's owned/restricted pits within 10 miles
Count of this competitor's owned/restricted pits within 25 miles
Count of this competitor's owned/restricted pits within 50 miles
Highest quality rating among this competitor's owned/restricted pits within 25 miles
formula: MAX(pit.Rating for pit in competitor_owned_pits WHERE distance <= 25 miles)

description: Flag: this competitor has an owned/restricted pit within 25 miles (0/1)
Distance in miles to the nearest Knife River pending pit (9999 if no coordinates)
formula: MIN(haversine_miles(project_loc; pit_loc) for pit in knife_river_pending_pits); 9999 if no coordinates

description: Count of Knife River pending pits within 25 miles
Nearest open pit distance minus competitor's nearest owned pit distance (positive = competitor has a closer pit than the open market)
Median distance to all pits minus competitor's nearest owned pit distance (positive = competitor is better-positioned than the median)
Flag: competitor's nearest owned pit is within 25 miles and at least 10 miles closer than the nearest open pit (0/1)
